assertions.detail: If the root correspondence and eventual cylinder intertwining are supplied separately, a finite C_sw is the uniform state-weighted local interaction input for the common-core generator refinement. This contract does not identify the generator intertwining with the envelope alone.
assertions.name: conditional-common-core-role

common_core_input.not_proved: rootwise/eventual generator intertwining and infinite-volume closure

family.cofinal_definition: The cofinal PAH-OMC-004 two-row strip G_n for every integer n>=2, with the same neutral inclusions J_(n,n+1) and the same geometric root-support rule as PAH-OMC-009.

non_claims: PAH-OMC-010 is a researcher-owned norm contract, not an external source or physical authority.
A positive state-weighted envelope does not retroactively repair the R-489 unweighted sup-state no-go.
A finite C_sw is only a uniform local-form input; it does not prove eventual generator intertwining, an infinite-volume automorphism or an ordered limit.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, event horizon, gravity, QFT, Yang--Mills, mass-gap, cosmic-origin or TOE conclusion follows.

scope.carrier_family: The cofinal PAH-OMC-004 two-row strip G_n for every integer n>=2, with the same neutral inclusions J_(n,n+1) and the same geometric root-support rule as PAH-OMC-009.
scope.common_core_input: If the root correspondence and eventual cylinder intertwining are supplied separately, a finite C_sw is the uniform state-weighted local interaction input for the common-core generator refinement. This contract does not identify the generator intertwining with the envelope alone.
scope.functional: Exactly PAH-001 F_rho, with no added term, counterterm, parameter transport, averaging or rate modification.
scope.local_interaction_sum: I_(n,R)(x)=sum_(r:x in supp(r)) w(r) sum_(omega in dom(r)) W_(n,R)(omega)c_r^(n,R)(omega), where c_r=m_r exp[-(F(r omega)-F(omega))/2] is the unchanged PAH-001 rate.
scope.norm: For bounded f on the finite invariant cylinder domain, ||f||_(2,W;n,R)^2=sum_(omega in Omega_(rho_R,Q)) W_(n,R)(omega)|f(omega)|^2. The common state-weighted norm is the family of these norms together with the root interaction seminorm below.
scope.observable_algebra: A_cyl is the algebraic union of bounded gauge- and anchor-automorphism-invariant cylinder observables generated by finitely many ell_v and closed-face holonomy characters. The R-488 coordinates (ell_a,ell_d,H_0,H_1) remain included.
scope.observable_nonzero_rule: For every finite n and R, each R-488 generator ell_a, ell_d, H_0 and H_1 must have strictly positive ||.||_(2,W;n,R) norm; a weight that annihilates any one is rejected.
scope.root_support: For every directed PAH root r, supp(r) is the maximal geometric vertex closure of every displayed PAH-001 energy term that can change under r: phase roots use the incident vertex star, aperture roots the closed two-cell star of the vertex, radial roots the closed two-cell stars of both endpoints, and link roots the closed two-cell star of the link and incident faces.
scope.root_weight: w(r)=1+|supp(r)|. It is positive, geometric, state-independent and changes no PAH-001 rate.
scope.state_space: The displayed PAH-001 finite configuration space Omega_(rho,Q) with Q=1, K=2, M_s=M_psi=1, epsilon=1/2, and all five displayed couplings and beta=nu=1 fixed to one; R_max=R ranges over positive integers and tends to infinity.
scope.state_weight: W_(n,R)(omega)=pi_(rho_R,Q)(omega)=Z_(n,R)^(-1) exp(-F_(rho_R)(omega)), the normalized positive Gibbs weight already declared by PAH-001 at beta=1.
scope.uniform_target: Prove or refute C_sw=sup_(R>=1) sup_(n>=2) sup_(x in V_n) I_(n,R)(x)<infinity.
